answer:
Your records show two prescriptions still marked as active. The first is empagliflozin (Jardiance) 10 mg, one tablet by mouth each morning. The second is atorvastatin 20 mg, one tablet by mouth once a day. Both were prescribed on 20 February 2025, and nothing in the records marks either one as stopped. Metformin is not current: it was marked as ended on 15 April 2024, and the records give no reason.

The records show prescriptions, not what you actually pick up or take. They have no pharmacy fill or refill entries, so please confirm with your pharmacy or your pill bottles what you are taking now. Tell your doctor about any over-the-counter medicines or supplements too, since those would not appear in these records.
